loglevel.description: Default log level for ytcc operations. Options: critical, info, debug.

output.description: Default output format for commands. Options: json, table, xsv, rss, plain.

separator.description: Delimiter used in XSV output format.

truncate.description: Table truncation setting. Options: max, no, or an integer N.

subscriptions.description: List of playlist subscriptions to track.

subscriptions.items.description: A single subscription entry. Note: type is object for structure, but items are flat fields as required by schema constraints for list-of-objects representation in this format context. Specifically: name (string), url (string), reverse (bool). If using the strict 'items' as a FLAT map field-name -> schema constraint: name -> {type: string, default: '', description: 'Name used to refer to the playlist'}, url -> {type: string, default: '', description: 'URL to the playlist'}, reverse -> {type: bool, default: false, description: 'Check the playlist in reverse order.'}
